lines.zh: 我踩着沙走，脚趾张得很开。
lines.en: I walk the sand with my toes spread wide.
The stones of the dry bed are hard underfoot.
A few steps, a pause, a blank look upward.

lines.zh: 沙丘上的风把我羽毛吹偏。
lines.en: The dune wind pushes my feathers aside.
My frame is a light one.
Any little sound and I spring away.
The grass on the floodplain is thin.
Head down, I peck as I walk.
My legs serve me better than my wings.
Three-toed prints stay in the sand.
The sun bleaches the sand.
I walk downwind to catch scents.
My long shadow trails on the sand.
Walking on sand makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我绕着石头堆走了一圈。
lines.en: I walk a circle around the stones.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，影子拉得很长。
lines.en: The sun slanted, shadows stretched long.
I stand on a white stone.
I dip my head and peck the sand.
Something moves under the sand.
I tilt my head to listen.
When the wind shifts, I turn.
I know this stretch of sand.
My feathers are brown.
A shadow passes overhead.
I crouch down at once.
It was only a bird.
I shake the sand from my long legs.
There is grass behind the dune.

lines.zh: 我在干河床上一惊，抬头发呆。
lines.en: Startled on the dry riverbed, I stare into nothing.
A faint sound comes from beyond the dune.
You come from the far end of the bed.
I take two more steps back.
You stand a head above me.
I do not much like that.
Your hands are empty.
Then I will stand a little longer.
What are you looking at me for?
There is nothing to see.

lines.zh: 你往前一步，我就往后退一步。
lines.en: You step forward, I step back.

lines.zh: 你的影子遮住了我的太阳。
lines.en: Your shadow blocks my sun.

lines.zh: 细长的腿一软，我叫出声。
lines.en: My slender legs buckle, and I cry out.
Two feathers come loose.
I spring a short way off.
My leg is a little lame.
I stop to look at the wound.
Blood drips onto the sand.
I can still run.
I tuck one leg up.
I limp as I go.
Blood clumps the sand.
Is that grass in your hand?
It looks like fibre.
I can eat that.
Set it on the sand.
Move away and I will come.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西我看见了。
lines.en: I saw what you set down.
Let me be sure you are still.
Stand still and I will come.
I know things that lie on sand.
Is that dry grass in your hand?

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚趾，我跳开。
lines.en: You step on my toe; I hop away.
I let out a shriek.
I hop aside.
Sand kicks up around me.

lines.zh: 你碰了我，我踉跄了一下。
lines.en: You bump me and I stumble.

lines.zh: 河床上一点动静，我就惊了。
lines.en: One sound on the riverbed and I bolt.
You have packed the sand down.

lines.zh: 胆小，所以走冲积平原的边。
lines.en: Timid, so I take the edge of the floodplain.
Do not follow behind me.
Startled, my thin legs run three steps first.
There are other prints behind the dune.
I call once. Nothing answers.
I follow them with my eyes.

lines.zh: 同类的声音，在河床那头。
lines.en: A call from my own kind, down the riverbed.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的小家伙，胆子很小。
lines.en: A small Cretaceous creature, easily spooked.
I lift my head and call.
An answer comes from far off.
That voice is thinner than mine.
I head that way.
It is not far ahead of me.
Something shows in the sand.
I push the sand aside with my bill.
It is only a bone.
I lick it; no taste.
I bury it again.
It is half buried in the sand.
I scratch at it twice.
That thing is not edible.
I pick it up in my beak; it won't hold.
Something else lies under the sand.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的脖子就转过去。
lines.en: When you move, my neck turns.
I back away.
The grass is taller over there.
I hide in it.
You picked up a stone.
I have no stone.
That is not fair.
I back away, looking for grass.
The grass you stepped through is still swaying.
My legs are already bent.
Take one step forward and see.

lines.zh: 匍匐着的草正好够我藏。
lines.en: The low grass is just enough cover.

lines.zh: 我从草缝里看你，胆小但要护食。
lines.en: I watch through the grass, timid but guarding food.
You stop, and so do I.
You turn your head and I crouch low.
I crouch in the grass and stay still.
Each of your steps sounds in the sand.
That sound tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，盯着你的手。
lines.en: I stretch my neck, watching your hands.
One lift of your foot and I know.

lines.zh: 沙地上没有能藏身的地方。
lines.en: There is nowhere to hide on sand.
Then I will head for the stones.
The stones are wider than I am.
I squeeze in and vanish.
The sand slides downward.
I spring up and kick at your leg.

lines.zh: 爪子在你裤腿上划了一下。
lines.en: My claws rake across your trouser leg.
It startled me too.
I run off the moment I land.
I kick out, claws first.
Then I turn and run.

lines.zh: 你追不上我拐弯的速度。
lines.en: You cannot match me in a turn.
I call out when I spring.
Consider that a warning.
I startle easily, but my claws are sharp.
I slip as I land.
Up again with another kick.
There is wind on the dry riverbed.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘背后走出来了。
lines.en: I walked out from behind the dune.
The sand underfoot is loose.
No water here, but there is grass.
I shake the sand from my feathers.
There is a pile of stones in the distance.
Voices carry from behind the dune.
The sky here is wider than the riverbed.
On the sand, I run fast.
Sand fills the gaps between my toes.
I look for grass first.
The dune's slope is steep.
I slid down it.
There is grass on the wind.
The fire passes and my feathers scorch.
I roll down the dune.
Water fills my bill; I flail.

lines.zh: 沙被掀起来，我翻了个身。
lines.en: The sand erupts and I tumble over.

lines.zh: 一根尖的东西扎进我的腿。
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my leg.
That light makes my legs fail.
The grass has dried; I walk slowly.
Lightning strikes and the sand burns black.
The sand beneath me is gone.
